scope: Two Registry message operations, pure snapshot projection helper, modified-origin notice and targeted observation/current-artifact infrastructure only.

design.stateOwner: InMemoryRuntimeTaskRegistry remains the sole snapshot writer; existing TaskWaitSubscriptions remains unchanged.
design.projection: Native copy into an own writable pendingMessages slot, then invoke the buffer producer; append uses lazy public-update patcher, drain returns optional replacement for one direct commit.
commonExpressionsRetained: native array spread and nullish fallback
fixed API/field names and public update call
design.notAdopted: Manual own-key/descriptor reimplementation proposed earlier was rejected as unnecessary complexity.
design.sourceExposure: Exact predecessor and existing source-derived behavior packet read before implementation.
design.license: Project continues Apache-2.0, existing third-party/origin history retained.
